# Scenario: proxy.target.url only (no project folder / compose) → SkipCompose;
# nginx reverse-proxies to a resolvable sibling on apinfra_proxy_net (Host from URL).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: url-only SkipCompose edge'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'skip compose project=e2e-edge \(url-only target\)'
stderr 'done duration='
! stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'

docker-assert-running apinfra-proxy
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-origin-web
! exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-edge

# URL Host reaches sibling on proxy net (not edge's own compose DNS).
exec curl -sf --resolve e2e-edge.apinfra.test:80:127.0.0.1 http://e2e-edge.apinfra.test/
stdout 'ORIGIN_OK'
exec curl -sI --resolve e2e-edge.apinfra.test:80:127.0.0.1 http://e2e-edge.apinfra.test/
! stdout '301'

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-origin
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 19992
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none
  - name: e2e-edge
    enabled: true
    # no project folder / docker-compose.yml — URL-only (SkipCompose)
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-edge.apinfra.test
      target:
        url: http://web.apinfra_e2e-origin
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-origin/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=ORIGIN_OK"]

-- .env --
